notes: QA pass (2026-09-21): the LHAASO Science Book (arXiv:1905.02773) coordinate this note used to flag as an unverified candidate remains unfetchable, but an independent QA re-derivation found and fetched (on two separate mirrors) a different, peer-reviewed paper stating the same figure to the hundredth of an arcsecond -- Chinese Physics C 46, 030001 (2022), doi:10.1088/1674-1137/ac3fa6. summary.plain: The LHAASO cosmic-ray and gamma-ray observatory on Haizi Mountain, Daocheng County, Sichuan, China.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:lhaaso-daocheng. Drawn as a single published reference point (Chinese Physics C 46, 030001 (2022)); KM2A (circular, ~575-635 m radius) and WCDA (78,000 m2, three pools) are described with enough shape detail to draw and are now anchorable to this tighter point, but no source states their offset/orientation from it, so neither is drawn (see geometry record and REVIEW_geometry_qa.md backlog).
